silhouette.reason: Long refined face and pointed ears read as an elf; the hair is a tight grooved helmet with two flat ribbons behind the ears.
fixes: fuller hair volume over the crown and ribbons that fan over the shoulders
lengthen the ear tip another 1–2 cm

proportions.reason: Narrow jaw, long face, high zygoma and refined nose read as declared; eye spacing on spec.
fixes: stronger almond tilt of the eyes

materials.reason: Vertex colour on the plain strip: skin zones (flush, lips, cool sockets) separate by hue but not by roughness or subsurface; the hair is the same material as the skin, so it reads as sculpted clay; there is a pale band of bare skin under the hair helmet edge at the hairline in hero.png.
fixes: a skin strip with subsurface-like roughness/sheen and a hair strip with anisotropic sheen
darker hair roots and per-lock value variation along each lock
close the hairline: extend the hair mass to the skin (or tint the scalp under it to the root colour) so no pale band shows

detail.reason: Primary and secondary forms come from a real anatomical base (lids, nasolabial area, lips, ear helix, clavicles, sternocleidomastoid), but there is no tertiary layer (pores, wrinkles) and the hair is evenly spaced grooves.
fixes: LOD0 wrinkle/pore displacement on the subdivided base driven by age
varied lock widths and a parting instead of evenly spaced grooves

wear.reason: Pristine: seeded asymmetry and age/weight knobs are the only story; no scars, stubble, blemishes, sun-darkened skin or dirt.
fixes: seeded scar/blemish marks in vertex colour
stubble shadow on the jaw and age-driven darkening under the eyes

lod.reason: LOD2 in sheet.png loses the ear tips and the hair ribbons entirely, the mouth area turns into dark patches and the bust edge is ragged: the elf no longer reads as an elf at distance.
fixes: keep the ears and ribbons from the LOD1 mesh at LOD2, or thicken thin parts before the re-mesh

technical.reason: QA PASS at every LOD; 126.4k / 51.6k / 8.2k tris (hair ribbons are the bulk); 2 draws.
